title: Crucible items document
description: The data the Eisenhower matrix crucible shows. Written by people, by task-brazer, or by the crucible-items AI skill; read by index.html from a file, an S3 object, a DynamoDB item or any HTTPS URL.

title.description: Page title; also the headline when there is no goal.

goal.description: The headline counts down to this date.

linkBase.description: An item's key is appended to this to make its link.

quadrants.description: Rename quadrants. A string sets the name; an object sets the name and the plain-language hint.

items.description: In priority order: the number on each piece is its position. Reads best with up to about 20.

when.description: A date, or a whole number of days from today (negative is in the past).

id.description: Stable id, e.g. jira:OPS-12. Written by task-brazer; optional for hand-written files.

by.description: When the next step is due. Sets the heat and the distance from the center. null or absent: black heat, on the rim.

deadline.description: The outer deadline, if different from by. Shown in the list only.

next.description: The next step, in a sentence.

key.description: A ticket key. With linkBase it becomes a link.

url.description: A link for the item; overrides linkBase.

source.description: Where the item came from, shown when there is no key.
